messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning to cut release/1.17 on Thu 2026-03-19. Please get version bumps + changelog PRs in by EOD Wed (18th).
raj: Ack. Which changes are considered blockers for the cut?
sophia: Anything that affects API compatibility or runtime flags. Minor docs and readme tweaks can be post-cut.
luis: Quick question: do we still want the strict backport policy (only semver-patch and security fixes)?
maya: Yes — backports should be limited to: security fixes, crash/availability fixes, and regressions that block paying customers. Nonblocking fixes go to the next minor.
olivia: For backport requests, please: 1) label PR with `needs-backport` + `backport-priority` (high/low), 2) include target release branch in PR body, 3) ping release lead.
raj: If someone needs an exception (e.g., important UX fix), what's the approval flow?
maya: Ask product + release lead (that's me) in-thread. If both approve, mark `backport-exempt` and add a short rationale. Keep exceptions rare.
sophia: Also, reminder to run the changelog script: `./scripts/generate_changelog --since v1.16` — put generated file in `changelogs/1.17.md`.
luis: For cherry-picks, can we standardize the git commands? Putting this here for copy-paste:
```
# example cherry-pick flow
git checkout -b backport/PR-123-release/1.17
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
# fix conflicts, then
git push origin backport/PR-123-release/1.17
```
olivia: deploy-bot, can you create the release/1.17 branch after we hit cutoff?
deploy-bot: release/1.17 branch will be created automatically at cutoff (2026-03-19T16:00:00Z). I'll post the branch link + new branch protection rules. :gear:
maya: Perfect — plan for a short smoke window after cut (30m). Please run canary tests and post thumbs if green.
raj: I'm on canary, will run the test harness and report.
sophia: Changelog PRs: if you touch multiple subsystems, please add subsystem tags in the changelog header so docs can route updates.
luis: One more: reminder to update any pinned model versions in infra configs if the cut includes runtime changes.
maya: Thanks all. If you're planning a backport, create the backport PR early so reviewers have time. Ping me here when it's ready and I'll triage. :thumbsup:
